claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs from 9 to 12 November 2026.
Invest.Rio and Maravalley are taking ten startups to Web Summit Lisbon.
Startups.com.br reported the startup call on 18 September 2026.
The call was for startups under six years old with fewer than 100 employees.
Gol opened its first intercontinental route, Rio to Lisbon from Galeão, a few weeks before the ten startups' report.
Gol's Rio to Lisbon route runs five flights a week from 24 November 2026.
Startups.com.br named the ten startups and reported Gol provides their tickets on 26 October 2026.
Correio da Manhã reported the same ten startups on 25 October 2026.
Maravalley ran a mission to VivaTech in Paris in June 2026 with Business France's delegation.
Nine of the ten startups are listed on Web Summit's site from Brazil, and sheerME is listed from Portugal.
Sebrae says 12 Brazilian states run their own missions to this year's Web Summit, without naming them.
Eighteen Brazilian founders and team members are on the Startup Showcase stages at Web Summit.
